name: LinkedIn Jobs MCP
description: LinkedIn-powered job search with rich filtering: workplace type (Remote/Hybrid/On-Site), employment type, sponsorship, easy-apply, and recency filters. Complements Indeed for broader discovery.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn job listings with workplace, employment, and recency filters

notes: No API key required. Supports workplace_types: Remote, Hybrid, On-Site. Supports posted_date: ONE, THREE, SEVEN (days). Use alongside Indeed MCP for maximum coverage.
